rationale: Describes capturing and forwarding service-mesh HTTP/2 traffic, plaintext conversion, and TLS protection between endpoints—conventional packet inspection and transport security functions.
evidence_spans: captures the HTTP/2 traffic flowing through the service mesh internally before it is converted from plaintext to mTLS. It generates the plaintext representation of that traffic and forwards it to a packet broker.
This traffic is encrypted between Pcapper and the packet broker via outer TLS wrapper using keys and certs that identify both ends.
